description: This file provides formatting utility functions for CLI output in a sandbox environment, including status formatting and counting functions for items with specific properties.

methods.name: export function formatStatus(running: boolean): string { formatStatus
methods.description: Formats a boolean status into a colored string indicating if a process is running or stopped.

methods.name: export function formatSimpleStatus(running: boolean): string { formatSimpleStatus
methods.description: Formats a boolean status into a simple string: 'running' or 'stopped'.

methods.name: export function formatImageMatch(matches: boolean): string { formatImageMatch
methods.description: Formats a boolean indicating image match status into a check mark or warning icon.

methods.name: export function countRunning<T extends { running: boolean }>(items: T[]): number { countRunning
methods.description: Counts the number of items in an array that have 'running' set to true.

methods.description: Counts the number of items in an array that have 'imageMatch' set to false.
